one_liner_zh: 迪爾EPS大幅超預期15%、營收年增4.53%，農機週期下仍展現成本韌性。
one_liner_en: Deere beat EPS by a strong 15% with 4.53% revenue growth, showing cost resilience through the ag cycle.
ai_view_zh: 訊號正向：15%的EPS大幅超標，顯示在農機週期下行環境中迪爾的成本控制與訂價紀律優異，獲利韌性勝於營收。短期超標激勵情緒，但市場會聚焦需求端是否落底；33.07倍本益比在週期股屬偏高，須留意評價風險。中期關鍵在農民收入與換購週期。追蹤指標：各部門營收與營業利潤率、通路庫存水準、精準農業滲透率與訂閱收入、全年淨利指引，以及大型農機訂單能見度。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive: a strong 15% EPS beat shows excellent cost control and pricing discipline through a down ag cycle, with earnings resilience outpacing revenue. Near-term the beat lifts sentiment, but the market will focus on whether demand is bottoming; a 33.07x P/E is high for a cyclical, warranting valuation caution. Mid-term, farm income and the replacement cycle are key. Track: segment revenue and operating margins, channel inventory levels, precision-ag penetration and subscription revenue, full-year net income guidance, and large-equipment order visibility.
highlights_zh: EPS 6.55美元，大幅超越預期5.70美元，正向驚喜15.01%
營收130.9億美元，年增4.53%於農機週期下尚屬穩定
精準農業與自動化技術提升產品附加價值
成本控制與庫存管理支撐獲利率表現
highlights_en: EPS of $6.55 strongly beat the $5.70 estimate, a 15.01% positive surprise
Revenue of $13.09B grew 4.53%, stable given the ag cycle
Precision agriculture and automation lift product value-add
Cost control and inventory management support margin performance
risks_zh: 農產品價格與農民收入下行抑制設備換購需求
農機景氣循環與通路庫存調整風險
本益比33.07在週期高點評價偏滿
risks_en: Lower crop prices and farm income suppress equipment replacement demand
A 33.07x P/E looks full at a cyclical peak
